question: When and where was the Veda Samaj, inspired by the Brahmo Samaj, established?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Madras 1864**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Veda Samaj** was inspired by the **Brahmo Samaj**, a movement that aimed at reforming Hinduism and promoting monotheism.
 
• It was established in **Madras** (now Chennai) in the year **1864**.
 
• The Veda Samaj, also known as the **Brahmo Samaj of South India**, played a crucial role in social and religious reform in the region.
 
• Its objectives included the promotion of **education**, **abolition of caste discrimination**, and the **upliftment of women**.
 
• The Veda Samaj's establishment in Madras marked the spread of Brahmo Samaj's influence beyond Bengal, reaching other parts of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Brahmo Samaj**__

 
 
• The Brahmo Samaj was founded by **Raja Ram Mohan Roy** in **1828**.
 
• It aimed at reforming Hindu society by **eliminating social evils** like sati, child marriage, and caste discrimination.
 
• The movement promoted **monotheism** and **rational thinking**.
